schedulers.title: Schedulers
schedulers.description: Assign scheduler switch entities to each day mode.

covers.title: Cover Heat Control
covers.description: Close covers automatically when the temperature exceeds the threshold during the configured time window.

data_description.cover_entities: Select the cover entities to control when it is too hot.
data_description.cover_temp_threshold: Temperature above which the selected action is triggered.
data_description.cover_time_start: Earliest time of day the feature is active. Also the time the forecast is checked for the proactive close.
data_description.cover_time_end: Latest time of day the feature is active. Also the earliest time the evening reopen can fire.
data_description.cover_action: 'Close' sends the standard close_cover command. 'Stop' sends stop_cover, halting movement mid-travel — useful for Somfy RTS covers (the My/favorite position is a separate button entity).
data_description.cover_my_button: Button to press to send covers to their favorite (My) position. If set, this button is used instead of the action below.
data_description.cover_weather_entity: Optional weather entity with daily forecasts. When set, covers close proactively at Active Window Start if today's forecast high exceeds the forecast threshold, instead of waiting for the outdoor sensor to actually cross it.
data_description.cover_forecast_threshold: Forecast daily high above which the proactive close triggers.
data_description.cover_evening_reopen_temp: Once covers have been closed by this automation, they reopen automatically after Active Window End as soon as the outdoor sensor drops to or below this temperature.

sunrise_schedulers.title: Sunrise Scheduler Adjustment
sunrise_schedulers.description: Adjust the opening time of scheduler switches daily based on sunrise, respecting a configurable earliest time.

data_description.sunrise_schedulers: Select the scheduler switch entities whose first timeslot will be adjusted at each new day.
data_description.sunrise_earliest: The opening time will be the later of sunrise and this value.

error.invalid_calendar: The specified calendar entity does not exist
